subject.character: ONE garden snail, grey-olive body, clear face, eyes on long stalks, small mouth; brown shell with an open brass padlock and iron chain; same face and colour throughout
subject.physicality: stalks snap in and out; skates on wet stone like a skater, slime trail glinting; skids sideways; hauls in jerks
subject.anti_action: weary serious face, brisk dry talker

second_characters: ONE fat banker, greasy suit, sleeve protectors, silent, sits on the desk behind the register
props: old cash register, blank keys, no digits; wooden work desk; coin: smooth gold, no engraving; padlock: smooth brass; chain: iron
environment: wet stone garden step after rain; dense background: wet leaves, moss, drops, clay pots
lighting: low sun behind-left through stalks, sky glow behind-right, glints on brass and gold, high contrast, bright
motion_rule: Camera orbits him every beat; leaves, pots, moss slide behind him. Shot size changes every beat. He skates, skids or hauls every beat. The banker works big in the foreground.
